text:
Lina (Partnerships): Quick heads-up 1: AeroMeds just accepted our ISV marketplace listing terms and signed a 12-month Dedicated pilot with a path to conversion. They also want a joint webinar in Q3. :tada:

Raj (Account Executive): Woo! They liked the Dedicated pricing and the co-sell rebate. Pilot commitment is for 2 dedicated nodes, scale plan after month 3. They emphasized compliance for PHI workloads.

Zoe (Product): Nice. Do we have permission to mention marketplace placement and co-sell in public materials? Need to clear with Legal before marketing pushes.

Lina (Partnerships): AeroMeds agreed to public announcement copy and a short blurb for the marketplace listing. Legal review required for the case study and any PHI examples.

Ben (Solutions): From the onboarding side: we'll provision a VPC Private flow for their PHI staging cluster and run a migration workshop week-of-May 12. I'll drop the onboarding checklist in the tracker.

Claire (Marketing): I'll draft a short joint press email and a landing card. Can we get a customer quote? A 1-2 line exec quote would be ideal.

Raj (Account Executive): Their Head of ML is okay with a quote focused on latency and reliability. Suggest: "Redwood's Dedicated pilot cut inference latency and simplified our HIPAA path." I'll get final sign-off by Thursday.

Zoe (Product): Engineering note: we used a quantization + prefix cache config in the pre-prod perf run that shaved p50 by ~35%. Ben, can you capture the config so we can include a small tech callout (non-sensitive)?

Ben (Solutions): Will do. Snippet for the doc: "batch_target_ms=25, max_batch=48; kv_cache=enabled; quant_profile=int8". They were fine with a short technical appendix.

OpsBot: marketplace-listing-draft created by Claire at https://redwood.internal/marketplace-drafts/aeromeds (access: partners-marketing)

Lina (Partnerships): Also adding a joint webinar to the partnerships tracker. Proposed format: 30-minute product demo + 15-minute customer Q&A. @Claire can you coordinate dates with AeroMeds?

Claire (Marketing): Yep. I'll propose three slots in July and ping their comms lead. Also planning a short case-study blog for our healthcare vertical series.

Raj (Account Executive): Timeline: pilot start May 1, migration workshop week 2, public marketplace listing + announcement targeted for July 10 (pending Legal).

Zoe (Product): Heads-up for SRE: AeroMeds asked about failover SLOs. We should ensure the dedicated pool has the fallback routing policy enabled for region failover.

Ben (Solutions): Noted. I'll open a runbook item for failover testing during the pilot ramp.

Lina (Partnerships): Great work team. This is a solid anchor for our healthcare ISV push. :raised_hands:
